Hi Priya,

Thanks again for the walkthrough last week. Nimbus is moving forward with the renewal and a +35% capacity uplift for Q3. Procurement asked me to collect the onboarding evidence and confirm the revised commercial terms before they approve the PO. Specifically they need:

- Updated vendor onboarding checklist with SOC2/Security contact details
